## **1\. Introduction**

1. ### **About Heuristic Evaluation**

   Heuristic evaluation is method for identifying usability and visual problems of user interface against a set heuristic principles that involves design experts. Employing experts to assess products is help for enhance user satisfaction and ensures a product’s design is intuitive and user friendly. Heuristics evaluation is an efficient way to uncovering usability problem and providing solutions with critical insights that rely on evaluator’s experiences and expertise.   
   

2. ### **The process to conduct evaluation**

1. Walkthrough the products to identify the main flow to analyze.  
2. Clearly recording all issues encountered and examine each elements according to heuristic principles.  
3. Conduct assessments and analyze the findings by give a severity rating and suggest potential solutions to these problems.  
   

3. ### **Heuristics Principles**

   We used Jakob Nielsen’s 10 heuristics principles   
   

| No | Principles | Description |  |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | :---- |
| 1\. | Visibility of system status | The design should keep user informed about what’s happening and provide feedback for their actions  | Is the user aware of their current position within the user journey? Is the user notified about changes in their user journey? Is the user aware of the factors that can have a significant impact on their user experience? |
| 2\. | Match between system and real world | The design should speaks the user’s language and follow real word conventions | Are UI elements and interaction prompts easily recognisable? Does the online experience replicate the familiarity of offline actions and behaviour? Does the website make use of jargon that need an explanation? If used, are they clearly explained? |
| 3\. | User control & freedom | Give user a freedom to take the actions they see fit and the design should provide an emergency exit to leave | Is the user able to exit all states such as pop-ups and multimedia? Is the exit state consistent and clear? Is the user able to use the core sections of the website without signing up? Does the user have control over their personal information? |
| 4\. | Consistency & standards | Used the same language, component action, that follow platform and industry convention | Is there a consistent design standard for all call to actions (CTA) on the application/website? Is there a consistent design standard for tone of voice? Is there a consistent design standard for headings? |
| 5\. | Error prevention | Either eliminate error-prone conditions, or check for them and present users with a confirmation option before they commit to the action  | Are there helpful constraints that prevent the user from making mistakes? Is the user guide with suggestions to prevent incorrect actions? Is the user presented with forgiving formatting for information? |
| 6\. | Recognition rather than recall  | Minimize the user’s memory load by making objects, actions, and options visible | Is the user presented with a list of recently viewed products or pages? Is the user presented with customised content based on previous actions? Is the user presented with navigational items that reduce cognitive load and aids recall? |
| 7\. | Flexibility and efficiency of use | The design should be flexible enough to allow users to complete tasks in a variety of ways, and efficient to allow users complete tasks quickly and easily. | Is the user presented with shortcuts to end goals?  Is the user able to tailor frequent actions? Is the user presented with ambient information for quick actions? |
| 8\. | Aesthetic and Minimalist Design | Interface should contain information that is relevant. We also need to consider aesthetic, while still paying attention to functionality | Is the user interface design simple and easy to understand? Is the user clear on what all the icons mean and why they’re included in the design? Are all forms easy to understand and effortless to fill in? |
| 9\. | Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors | Error messages should be expressed in plain language (no error codes), precisely indicate the problem, and constructively suggest a solution. | Is the user presented with error messages (as opposed to no message) when adding incorrect information in a form control?  Is the user presented with human-readable error messages that offer useful information on how to rectify the problem?  Is the user presented with polite error messages that don’t blame the user for the error? |
| 10\. | Help & Documentation | It may be necessary to provide documentation to help users understand how to complete their tasks.  | Is the user presented with clear steps/guidelines to use the product service?  Does the user have access to documentation with relevant topics to help reach their goal?  Is the user presented with other options of communication to enquire assistance to reach their goal?  |

   

4. ### **Severity Ratings for Heuristic Evaluation**

| Heuristic Criteria | Description | Rating Score |
| ----- | ----- | :---: |
| I don’t agree that this is a usability problem at all | There is no usability problem at all | 0 |
| Cosmetic problem only | Need not be fixed unless extra time is available on project | 1 |
| Minor usability problem | Fixing this should be given low priority | 2 |
| Major usability problem | Important to fix, so should be given high priority | 3 |
| Usability catastrophe | Imperative to fix this before product can be released | 4 |

## **2\. Scope Testing**

| No | Area | Bug Ditemukan | Detail Bug |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1\. | Registration & Authentication | Tidak | \- |
| 2\. | Team Invitation | Tidak | \- |
| 3\. | Channel Setup | Tidak | \- |
| 4\. | Inbox & Omnichannel | Ya | Ditemukan beberapa tampilan dan interaksi yang berpotensi membingungkan pengguna, seperti jumlah pesan yang tidak konsisten, serta filter yang sulit dikenali. |
| 5\. | Ticketing System  | Ya | Tidak ditemukan masalah pada fungsi utama. Namun terdapat beberapa ketidakkonsistenan ukuran komponen yang dapat memengaruhi kenyamanan dan kemudahan penggunaan |
| 6\. | Reporting & Dashboard | Ya | Visual card kurang memiliki pembeda yang jelas |
| 7\. | Settings | Ya | Beberapa pengaturan langsung tersimpan tanpa tombol Save atau Cancel, sehingga berisiko menyebabkan perubahan yang tidak disengaja. Selain itu, beberapa elemen tampilan dan pesan sistem masih kurang jelas bagi pengguna. |

## **3\. Evaluation Result**

| No | Area Improvement | Findings |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1\. | Inbox \- Belum Ditugaskan |  **Findings:** Angka pesan di sidebar dan list chat berbeda sehingga membingungkan total pesan **Heuristic violation:** Visibility of System Status **Severity:** 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Sinkronkan perhitungan jumlah pesan di seluruh area sistem |
| 2\. | Inbox \- Detail Percakapan |  **FIndings**: Tidak ada checkbox indicator dan informasi jumlah item yang dipilih **Heuristic Violation:** Recognition Rather Than Recal **Severity:** 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation**: Tampilkan counter seperti "2 anggota terpilih"  |
| 3\. | Inbox \- Filter |  **Findings**:  Tidak ada dropdown indicator sehingga terlihat seperti input field biasa **Heuristic Violation:** Consistency & Standards  **Severity:** 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation**: Tambahkan icon dropdown/ chevron |
| 4\. | Inbox \- Filter |  **Findings**: Warna text pada badge filter tidak terlihat jelas dan tidak ada clear all filter **Heuristic Violation**: Aesthetic & Minimalist Design **Severity:** 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation**: Tingkatkan kontras warna sesuai standar aksesibilitas, tambahkan aksi clear all filter |
| 5\. | Inbox \- Detail Percakapan |  **Findings**: Text keluar dari area button **Heuristic Violation**: Aesthetic & Minimalist Design  **Severity:** 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation**: Perbaiki responsive behavior, auto-resize button atau wrapping text. |
| 6\. | Inbox \- Tata Letak | ![][image1] **Findings**: Tidak ada tombol Done setelah update pengaturan visibilitas **Heuristic Violation**: User Control & Freedom  **Severity:** 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation**: Tambahkan tombol Done/ Close yang jelas setelah perubahan berhasil disimpan. |
| 7\. | Inbox \- Buat Tiket Baru |  **Findings**: Warna dan state aktif tombol kurang menonjol **Heuristic Violation**: Visibility of System Status **Severity:** 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation**: Gunakan ukuran dan gaya yang konsisten dengan tombol utama lainnya |
| 8\. | Tiket  |  **Findings**: Field dan badge memiliki ukuran yang berbeda-beda sehingga tampilan terasa tidak seragam **Heuristic Violation**: Consistency & Standards **Severity:** 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation**: Samakan ukuran field, badge, dan spacing agar konsisten di seluruh halaman |
| 9\. | Broadcast \- template |  **Findings**:Pengguna tidak bisa melihat tampilan/ preview dari template **Heuristic Violation**: Visibility of System Status  **Severity:** 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation**: Tambahkan opsi Preview Template |
| 10 | Broadcast \- Draft |  **Findings**: Icon broadcast tidak menunjukkan state aktif ketika submenu dipilih sehingga pengguna bingung apakah sedang berada di halaman broadcast **Heuristic Violation**: Visibility of System Status  **Severity:** 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation**: Tampilkan state aktif pada ikon dan menu broadcast saat pengguna berada di area tersebut |
| 11\. | Broadcast \- Draft |  **Findings**: Keterangan error menggunakan bahasa teknis yang sulit dipahami pengguna non-teknis **Heuristic Violation**: Match Between System & Real World **Severity:** 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation**: Gunakan wording yang lebih sederhana dan mudah dipahami, berikan petunjuk tindakan untuk menyelesaikan masalah |
| 12\. | Analytics \- Conversations |  **Findings**: Pengguna harus membaca satu per satu karena tidak ada pembeda visual yang kuat antar metrik **Heuristic Violation:** Recognition Rather Than Recall **Severity:** 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation**: Tambahkan ikon, warna aksen, atau grouping yang konsisten, gunakan hierarki visual agar jenis metrik lebih cepat dikenali |
| 13\. | Kontak \- Tambah Kontak |  **Findings**: Ukuran dan warna field berbeda-beda di dalam satu form **Heuristic Violation:** Consistency & Standards **Severity:** 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation**: Samakan ukuran, warna, border, dan spacing seluruh field pada form  |
| 14\. | Kontak \- Filter | **Findings**: Tidak ada filter by date/ terbaru, Pengguna sulit melacak kontak baru (harus ke halaman terakhir) **Heuristic Violation:** Flexibility & Efficiency of Use **Severity:** 2 (Minor)  **Solution/ Recommendation**: Tambahkan filter berdasarkan tanggal atau opsi terbaru |
| 15\. | Prospek \- Filter |  **Findings**:  Tombol tetap tampil meskipun tidak ada filter yang digunakan sehingga membingungkan **Heuristic Violation:** Visibility of System Status **Severity:** 2 (Minor)  **Solution/ Recommendation**: Sembunyikan CTA Hapus Semua ketika tidak ada filter aktif |
| 16\. | Prospek |  **Findings**: Field dan badge memiliki ukuran yang berbeda-beda sehingga tampilan terasa tidak seragam. **Heuristic Violation**: Consistency & Standards **Severity**: 2 (Minor)  **Solution/ Recommendation**: Samakan ukuran field, badge, dan spacing agar konsisten di seluruh halaman |
| 17\. | Settings \- roles |  **Findings**: Pada privacy settings/roles, perubahan diterapkan otomatis sehingga berisiko terjadi perubahan tidak disengaja **Heuristic Violation:** Error Prevention **Severity:** 3 **Solution/ Recommendation**: Tambahkan Save dan Cancel untuk mencegah perubahan tidak disengaja  |
| 18\. | Settings \- CSAT Survey |  **Findings**: Ukuran card toggle tidak sejajar dan berbeda ukuran **Heuristic Violation:** Consistency & Standards **Severity**: 1 **Solution/ Recommendation:** Samakan ukuran dan alignment seluruh card toggle.  |
| 19\. | Settings \- Widget |  **Findings**: Button kurang informatif, icon tidak familiar, checkbox tidak jelas fungsinya **Heuristic Violation:** Match Between System & Real World  **Severity**: 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Tambahkan label text yang menjelaskan fungsi komponen |
| 20\. | Settings \-  Whatsapp Web |  **Findings**: Button hilang sehingga tampilan tidak konsisten **Heuristic Violation:** Consistency & Standards  **Severity**: 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Tetap tampilkan button dalam state disabled daripada dihilangkan |
| 21\. | Settings \- WhatsApp Web |  **Findings**: Filter tidak memiliki opsi All/Clear Filter. Harus di klik di opsi yang sama untuk gajadi pilih **Heuristic Violation:** User Control & Freedom  **Severity**: 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Tambahkan opsi "All", "Reset", atau icon clear filter. |
| 22\. | Settings \- Roles |  **Findings**: Tidak ada tombol Save ketika mengubah setting **Heuristic Violation**: Error Prevention **Severity**: 3 **Solution/ Recommendation:** Tambahkan tombol Save dan confirmation sebelum perubahan diterapkan. |
| 23\. | Settings \- Shift Hours |  **Findings**: Tabel ga rapih, opsi titik tiga ga mepet kanan, kanan banyak space kosong. Dan gaada opsi hapus untuk shift hours nya **Heuristic Violation**: Flexibility & Efficiency of Use  **Severity**: 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Rapikan alignment tabel dan tambahkan aksi Delete untuk Shift Hours. |
| 24\. | Settings \- Tag |  **Findings**: Status Success menggunakan warna merah **Heuristic Violation**: Consistency & Standards **Severity**: 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Gunakan warna hijau yang sesuai dengan standar status sukses. |
| 25\. | Settings \-  Kontak Masuk Tim |  **Findings**: Tidak ada detail channel dan identifier di search, pengguna kesulitan membedakan hasil pencarian yang memiliki nama serupa. **Heuristic Violation**: Recognition Rather Than Recall **Severity**: 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Tampilkan channel, identifier, atau metadata relevan pada hasil pencarian |
| 26\. | Settings \- Tickets |  **Findings**: Judul tiap section tidak konsisten, section 1 ada title dan description, section 2 gaada title dan description **Heuristic Violation**: Consistency & Standards  **Severity**: 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Samakan pola title, description, dan styling di seluruh section |
| 27\. | Settings \- Tickets | **Findings**: Pada halaman Ticket \> Tipe Tiket \> Tambah Tipe Tiket, tidak terdapat tombol kembali maupun breadcrumb sehingga pengguna kesulitan memahami posisi saat ini dan cara kembali ke halaman sebelumnya **Heuristic Violation**: User Control & Freedom serta Recognition Rather Than Recall **Severity**: 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Tambahkan tombol Back yang jelas pada bagian atas halaman. Tambahkan breadcrumb navigation seperti: Ticket / Tipe Tiket / Tambah Tipe Tiket. Pastikan pengguna dapat kembali ke halaman sebelumnya tanpa harus menggunakan tombol browser |
| 28\. | Settings \- Jam Shift |  **Findings**: Button kurang terlihat **Heuristic Violation:** Visibility of System Status  **Severity**: 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Gunakan warna primary yang lebih jelas saat terdapat perubahan yang perlu disimpan |
| 29\. | Settings \- WhatsApp Web |  **Findings:** Pengguna tidak tahu tindakan apa yang dapat dilakukan untuk memperbaiki masalah **Heuristic Violation:** Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors **Severity**: 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Tambahkan rekomendasi aksi/ cta button untuk penyelesaian masalah |
| 30\. | Settings \- Tickets |   **Findings:** Form kurang clean, terlalu banyak kotak dan bentuk yang kurang familiar sehingga sulit dipahami, button tambah field kurang menonjol **Heuristic Violation:** Aesthetic & Minimalist Design **Severity**: 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Sederhanakan struktur form dan kurangi elemen visual yang tidak diperlukan, gunakan pola form yang lebih umum dan familiar bagi pengguna. Button memakai warna primary  |
| 31\. | Settings \- Anggota |  **Findings:** Tombol dropdown terlihat dapat diklik, namun tidak memberikan aksi apa pun sehingga membingungkan pengguna **Heuristic Violation:** Consistency & Standards **Severity**: 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Hapus dropdown jika tidak diperlukan |
|  |  |  **Findings:** Saat sidebar dalam kondisi minimize, pengguna sulit mengenali halaman atau menu yang sedang dipilih karena hanya menampilkan ikon **Heuristic Violation:** Visibility of System Status **Severity**: 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Tambahkan microinteraction saat pengguna melakukan hover pada ikon, seperti tooltip yang menampilkan nama menu atau label navigasi |
|  |  |  **Findings:** Daftar menu pada sidebar terlalu banyak sehingga membuat navigasi terlihat padat dan meningkatkan beban visual pengguna **Heuristic Violation:** Aesthetic & Minimalist Design **Severity**: 2 (Minor) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Tampilkan hanya channel atau menu yang aktif/digunakan. Channel yang dinonaktifkan pada settings tidak perlu ditampilkan di sidebar untuk mengurangi clutter |
|  |  |  **Findings:** Pada laptop dengan ukuran layar yang lebih kecil, panel atas tiket memakan terlalu banyak ruang sehingga area chat menjadi sempit dan bubble chat sulit dibaca **Heuristic Violation:** Flexibility & Efficiency of Use **Severity**: 3 (Major) **Solution/ Recommendation:** Pindahkan informasi deskripsi tiket ke panel kanan agar area percakapan memiliki ruang yang lebih luas dan nyaman dibaca pada berbagai ukuran layar |
